headline: RC-D built a deterministic, non-ideal Feistel PRP null object, independently confirmed independent of AES and of every prior instrument in this campaign, and confirmed genuinely deterministic. Both matched (2^30) and 8x (2^33) exposure arms read OUTCOME-A' -- the excess stays absent under this structured substitute too, narrowing but not resolving U4. Zero defects found by the independent validator. The previously-deferred O(1)-memory ideal-permutation lever for the cipher-substitution comparison is promoted to rank 1 for BATCH-015.
